title: incident-bot: oncall autodiagnostics + runbook linking enhancements
author: Priya Shah
description: Motivation: make autodiagnostics more actionable for oncall by surfacing high-confidence runbook links and adding lightweight debugging hints. This PR improves runbook linking heuristics, adds a confidence score field to suggestions, introduces compact diagnostics for pager messages, and wires these into the oncall Slack flow. It also adds unit tests and documentation for operators. Scope: - heuristic improvements to runbook candidate selection (title/token-match + metric correlation scoring) - confidence score and reason metadata included in suggestions - compact runbook snippet generation for Slack to reduce noise - opt-in feature flag for teams to enable linked runbook suggestions - telemetry events for suggestion click and adoption rate - docs and migration notes for runbook maintainers Implementation notes: - new module incident_bot.autodiag.runbook_linker implements candidate scoring and sampling - existing autodiag pipeline extended to emit "suggested_runbooks" field with score/reason - Slack message templates updated to include compact runbook snippets and link buttons - unit tests added for scoring edge cases and sampling behavior - telemetry: autodiag.suggested_runbook_shown and autodiag.runbook_clicked events. Backwards compatibility: suggestions are opt-in and the fallback behavior is unchanged when disabled. See release_notes for operator-facing changes and toggle instructions.

release_notes: Adds opt-in runbook linking to incident-bot autodiagnostics: operators can enable per-team suggestions which include a confidence score and compact runbook snippets for Slack. Feature is behind a flag and defaults to off. Backfill not required. See docs/oncall/runbook-linking.md for enablement and tuning guidance.
